# edX

> > edX is a leading online learning platform offering courses, certificates, and degrees from top universities and institutions in technology, business, and professional development.

edX provides accessible online education across diverse subjects including AI, Python, software engineering, and business administration. The platform serves both individual learners and enterprises through edX For Business, with offerings ranging from beginner courses to advanced executive education programs.

## Key Topics

- Online Learning
- Certificates & Degrees
- Python Programming
- Artificial Intelligence
- ChatGPT & AI
- Software Engineering
- Career Development
- Professional Development
- Executive Education
- edX For Business
- Enterprise Learning
- Corporate Training
- Skill Training
- Computer Programming
- Blockchain

## Getting Started

- [edX Homepage](https://www.edx.org): Main entry point for edX offering online courses, certificates, and degrees from leading institutions
- [Course Catalog & Topics](https://www.edx.org/learn): Browse edX's complete course catalog and topic library featuring Harvard, MIT, and IBM courses

## Technology & Programming

- [Python Programming Courses](https://www.edx.org/learn/python): Python programming courses for data science, AI, and software development
- [Software Engineering](https://www.edx.org/learn/software-engineering): Software engineering courses including Harvard's CS50x and programming languages
- [Computer Programming](https://www.edx.org/learn/computer-programming): Computer programming courses, certificates, and degree programs from top schools
- [Blockchain & Cryptocurrency](https://www.edx.org/learn/blockchain): Blockchain and cryptocurrency courses for finance and digital innovation skills

## AI & Emerging Technologies

- [ChatGPT & AI Courses](https://www.edx.org/learn/chatgpt): ChatGPT and AI courses with MicroBootCamps and executive education programs

## Business & Professional Development

- [edX For Business](https://business.edx.org): Enterprise learning and corporate training solutions for organizations
- [Business Administration](https://www.edx.org/learn/business-administration): Business administration courses covering management, marketing, and leadership skills
- [Excel & Data Analysis](https://www.edx.org/learn/excel): Microsoft Excel spreadsheet and data analysis courses for career development

## Languages & Other Skills

- [Spanish Language Courses](https://www.edx.org/learn/spanish): Spanish language courses and professional certificates from top universities
- [Architecture](https://www.edx.org/learn/architecture): Architecture courses, certificates, and degrees for diverse career pathways

## Career Guidance

- [Becoming a Cybersecurity Analyst](https://www.edx.org/become/how-to-become-a-cybersecurity-analyst): Career guide for cybersecurity analysts covering pathways, certifications, and skills
